$comment: document { kind: "topic", title, description, href } is this case's own shape. The listing section is the one listing.json draws: anchor posts (id posts, heading id posts__heading), its heading h2 because the view's h1 is the archive title, so card titles are h3 (body base 2 + 1). The listing is not the page's first section as a hero would be, but the view gives it no priority image (archive.json has no priorityMedia), so context.priorityMedia is false and every card image is lazy. Route data as listing/cards-with-pagination.json: pagination.hrefs maps page numbers to paths.
